people.descriptorSuggestion: King of Qi Allied against the Lü

en.exact: Zhou Yin, the Grand Marshal of Chu

units.zh: 荊王劉賈者，諸劉，不知其何屬初起時。
units.en: Liu Jia, the King of Jing, was a member of the Liu clan, though no one knows which branch he belonged to at the time of the initial uprising.
units.literal: King Jing Liu Jia was one of the various Liu clansmen; no one knows which branch he belonged to during the initial uprising.

units.zh: 漢王元年，還定三秦，劉賈為將軍，定塞地，從東擊項籍。
units.en: In the first year of the King of Han, after the Three Qin territories had been subdued, Liu Jia served as a general, pacifying the frontier regions before marching east to attack Xiang Ji.
units.literal: In the first year of the Han King, after pacifying the Three Qins, Liu Jia served as general, secured the border regions, and followed east to attack Xiang Yu.

units.zh: 漢四年，漢王之敗成皋，北渡河，得張耳、韓信軍，軍修武，深溝高壘，使劉賈將二萬人，騎數百，渡白馬津入楚地，燒其積聚，以破其業，無以給項王軍食。
units.en: In the fourth year of Han, after the King of Han suffered defeat at Chenggao and crossed the Yellow River northward, he joined forces with the armies of Zhang Er and Han Xin. He encamped at Xiuwu behind deep trenches and high ramparts, then dispatched Liu Jia with twenty thousand infantry and several hundred cavalry to cross at Baima Ford into Chu territory. There they burned the enemy's grain stores, devastating their supply lines so that Xiang Yu's army could no longer be fed.
units.literal: In Han year 4, when the Han King was defeated at Chenggao and crossed north over the river, obtaining the armies of Zhang Er and Han Xin, he stationed at Xiuwu with deep moats and high ramparts, commanding Liu Jia to lead 20,000 men and several hundred cavalry across the Baima Ford into Chu territory, burning their grain stores to disrupt their war effort and prevent them from supplying Xiang Yu's army with food.

units.zh: 已而楚兵擊劉賈，賈輒壁不肯與戰，而與彭越相保。
units.en: Before long, Chu forces struck at Liu Jia, but he fortified his position and refused to engage, instead joining with Peng Yue to hold firm.
units.literal: Soon after, Chu troops attacked Liu Jia, but Jia entrenched himself and refused to fight, instead holding out with Peng Yue.

units.zh: 漢五年，漢王追項籍至固陵，使劉賈南渡淮圍壽春。
units.en: In the fifth year of Han, the King of Han pursued Xiang Ji to Guling and ordered Liu Jia to cross the Huai River southward to lay siege to Shouchun.
units.literal: In Han year 5, the Han King pursued Xiang Yu to Guling, commanding Liu Jia to cross south over the Huai and besiege Shouchun.

units.zh: 還至，使人閒招楚大司馬周殷。
units.en: Upon his return, he sent agents to covertly win over Zhou Yin, the Grand Marshal of Chu.
units.literal: On the return, he sent agents to secretly recruit Chu's Grand Marshal Zhou Yin.

units.zh: 周殷反楚，佐劉賈舉九江，迎武王黥布兵，皆會垓下，共擊項籍。
units.en: Zhou Yin turned against Chu and helped Liu Jia seize the Jiujiang region. They then welcomed the forces of King Wu, Ying Bu, and all their armies converged at Gaixia to strike against Xiang Ji.
units.literal: Zhou Yin defected from Chu and assisted Liu Jia in capturing Jiujiang, welcoming King Wu Ying Bu's troops, all gathering at Gaixia to jointly attack Xiang Yu.

units.zh: 漢王因使劉賈將九江兵，與太尉盧綰西南擊臨江王共尉。
units.en: The King of Han then directed Liu Jia to lead the Jiujiang troops and, together with Grand Commandant Lu Wan, march southwest to attack Gong Wei, the King of Linjiang.
units.literal: The Han King then commanded Liu Jia to lead the Jiujiang troops southwest with Grand Commandant Lu Wan to attack King Linjiang Gong Wei.

units.zh: 共尉已死，以臨江為南郡。
units.en: After Gong Wei's death, the territory of Linjiang was converted into the Nan Commandery.
units.literal: Gong Wei had already died, so Linjiang was made into Nan Commandery.

units.zh: 漢六年春，會諸侯於陳，廢楚王信，囚之，分其地為二國。
units.en: In the spring of the sixth year of Han, the emperor assembled the feudal lords at Chen, deposed Han Xin, the King of Chu, had him imprisoned, and divided his territory into two kingdoms.
units.literal: In spring of Han year 6, he assembled the feudal lords at Chen, deposed King Chu Xin, imprisoned him, and divided his territory into two kingdoms.

units.zh: 當是時也，高祖子幼，昆弟少，又不賢，欲王同姓以鎮天下，乃詔曰：「將軍劉賈有功，及擇子弟可以為王者。」
units.en: At that time, Emperor Gaozu's sons were still young, and his brothers were few and lacked distinction. Wishing to install kings who shared his surname to anchor the realm, he issued an edict: 'General Liu Jia has rendered great service. Let worthy members of the clan be selected and made kings.'
units.literal: At this time, Gaozu's sons were young, his brothers few, and moreover not worthy; he wished to enfeoff kings of the same surname to stabilize the realm. He issued an edict saying: 'General Liu Jia has merit; let clansmen who can be made kings be selected.'

units.zh: 群臣皆曰：「立劉賈為荊王，王淮東五十二城；
units.en: All the ministers said: 'Let Liu Jia be established as King of Jing, to rule over fifty-two cities east of the Huai;
units.literal: All the ministers said: 'Establish Liu Jia as King of Jing, to rule over fifty-two cities east of the Huai;

units.zh: 高祖弟交為楚王，王淮西三十六城。」
units.en: and let Jiao, the emperor's younger brother, be made King of Chu, ruling over thirty-six cities west of the Huai.'
units.literal: Gaozu's younger brother Jiao as King of Chu, ruling over 36 cities west of the Huai.'

units.zh: 因立子肥為齊王。
units.en: He also established his son Fei as the King of Qi.
units.literal: He then established his son Fei as King of Qi.

units.zh: 始王昆弟劉氏也。
units.en: This marked the beginning of enfeoffing members of the Liu clan as kings.
units.literal: This began the enfeoffment of brothers from the Liu clan.

units.zh: 高祖十一年秋，淮南王黥布反，東擊荊。
units.en: In the autumn of the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, Ying Bu, the King of Huainan, rose in rebellion and marched east to attack the kingdom of Jing.
units.literal: In autumn of Gaozu year 11, King Huainan Ying Bu rebelled and marched east to attack Jing.

units.zh: 荊王賈與戰，不勝，走富陵，為布軍所殺。
units.en: King Jia of Jing fought against him but could not prevail. He fled to Fuling, where he was slain by Ying Bu's forces.
units.literal: King Jing Jia fought him but was defeated, fled to Fuling, and was killed by Bu's army.

units.zh: 高祖自擊破布。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu personally led the campaign that crushed Ying Bu.
units.literal: Gaozu personally attacked and defeated Bu.

units.zh: 十二年，立沛侯劉濞為吳王，王故荊地。
units.en: In the twelfth year, he installed Liu Pi, the Marquis of Pei, as the King of Wu, to rule over the former Jing territory.
units.literal: In year 12, he established Marquis Pei Liu Pi as King of Wu, ruling over the former Jing territory.

units.zh: 燕王劉澤者，諸劉遠屬也。
units.en: Liu Ze, the King of Yan, was a distant kinsman of the Liu clan.
units.literal: King Yan Liu Ze was a distant relation of the various Liu clansmen.

units.zh: 高帝三年，澤為郎中。
units.en: In the third year of Emperor Gao's reign, Liu Ze served as a palace gentleman.
units.literal: In Gaozu year 3, Ze served as a palace attendant.

units.zh: 高帝十一年，澤以將軍擊陳豨，得王黃，為營陵侯。
units.en: In the eleventh year, Liu Ze campaigned as a general against Chen Xi. He captured Wang Huang and was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Yingling.
units.literal: In Gaozu year 11, Ze as a general attacked Chen Xi, captured Wang Huang, and was made Marquis of Yingling.

units.zh: 高后時，齊人田生游乏資，以畫干營陵侯澤。
units.en: During the reign of Empress Dowager Gao, a man from Qi named Tian Sheng, who had exhausted his travel funds, approached the Marquis of Yingling with his stratagems.
units.literal: During Empress Gao's time, a man from Qi named Tian Sheng, traveling without funds, sought patronage from Marquis Yingling Ze by offering stratagems.

units.zh: 澤大說之，用金二百斤為田生壽。
units.en: Liu Ze was greatly delighted with him and presented Tian Sheng with two hundred jin of gold as a gift.
units.literal: Ze was greatly pleased with him and gave two hundred jin of gold to Tian Sheng as a gift.

units.zh: 田生已得金，即歸齊。
units.en: Once Tian Sheng had the gold in hand, he promptly returned to Qi.
units.literal: After Tian Sheng received the gold, he immediately returned to Qi.

units.zh: 二年，澤使人謂田生曰：「弗與矣。」
units.en: In the second year, Liu Ze sent a messenger to tell Tian Sheng: 'I will not help you anymore.'
units.literal: Two years later, Ze sent someone to tell Tian Sheng: 'I will not give [any more help].'

units.zh: 田生如長安，不見澤，而假大宅，令其子求事呂后所幸大謁者張子卿。
units.en: Tian Sheng traveled to Chang'an but did not call upon Liu Ze. Instead, he rented a grand residence and had his son seek a position under Zhang Ziqing, the Grand Usher who enjoyed the special favor of Empress Lü.
units.literal: Tian Sheng went to Chang'an but did not see Ze. Instead, he rented a large residence and had his son seek service with Zhang Ziqing, the Grand Usher favored by Empress Lü.

units.zh: 居數月，田生子請張卿臨，親修具。
units.en: After several months, Tian Sheng's son invited Zhang Qing to visit, personally preparing an elaborate feast for the occasion.
units.literal: After several months, Tian Sheng's son invited Zhang Qing to visit, preparing elaborate arrangements personally.

units.zh: 張卿許往。
units.en: Zhang Qing accepted the invitation.
units.literal: Zhang Qing agreed to go.

units.zh: 田生盛帷帳共具，譬如列侯。
units.en: Tian Sheng laid out sumptuous curtains and furnishings rivaling those of a marquis's household.
units.literal: Tian Sheng prepared lavish curtains and furnishings, comparable to those of marquises.

units.zh: 張卿驚。
units.en: Zhang Qing was taken aback.
units.literal: Zhang Qing was astonished.

units.zh: 酒酣，乃屏人說張卿曰：「臣觀諸侯王邸弟百餘，皆高祖一切功臣。
units.en: When the wine was flowing freely, Tian Sheng dismissed the attendants and spoke to Zhang Qing in confidence: 'I have observed that more than a hundred youths lodged at the feudal kings' mansions in the capital are all descendants of Emperor Gaozu's meritorious officials.
units.literal: When the wine flowed freely, Tian Sheng dismissed the attendants and spoke confidentially to Zhang Qing: 'I have observed that more than a hundred youths lodged at the feudal kings' mansions in the capital are all descendants of Emperor Gaozu's meritorious officials.

units.zh: 今呂氏雅故本推轂高帝就天下，功至大，又親戚太后之重。
units.en: Now the Lü clan, as old allies, originally helped propel Emperor Gao to conquer the realm. Their merit is immense, and they hold the additional weight of being close kinsmen of the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: Now the Lü clan, as old allies, originally helped Gaozu from the outset to win the realm; their merit is extremely great, and moreover they bear the weight of kinship with the Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 太后春秋長，諸呂弱，太后欲立呂產為［呂］王，王代。
units.en: The Empress Dowager is advanced in years, and the Lü are still weak. She wishes to establish Lü Chan as the King of Lü, to rule over Dai.
units.literal: The empress dowager is advanced in years, the various Lü are weak, the empress dowager wishes to establish Lü Chan as king of Lü, ruling Dai.

units.zh: 太后又重發之，恐大臣不聽。
units.en: Yet the Empress Dowager hesitates to raise the matter again, fearing the ministers will refuse.
units.literal: The empress dowager finds it hard to bring the matter up again, fearing the ministers will not heed it.

units.zh: 今卿最幸，大臣所敬，何不風大臣以聞太后，太后必喜。
units.en: You are the most favored at court and respected by the ministers. Why not hint to them to bring this matter before the Empress Dowager? She will certainly be delighted.
units.literal: Now you are most favored, respected by the ministers—why not sound out the ministers to inform the empress dowager? The empress dowager will certainly be pleased.

units.zh: 諸呂已王，萬戶侯亦卿之有。
units.en: Once the Lü clan members are made kings, a marquisate of ten thousand households will be yours as well.
units.literal: Once the various Lü are kings, a marquisate of ten thousand households will also be yours.

units.zh: 太后心欲之，而卿為內臣，不急發，恐禍及身矣。」
units.en: The Empress Dowager desires this in her heart. As an inner minister, if you do not act swiftly, I fear disaster will fall upon you.'
units.literal: The empress dowager desires this in her heart, and you as an inner minister, if you do not act quickly, disaster may befall you.'

units.zh: 張卿大然之，乃風大臣語太后。
units.en: Zhang Qing wholeheartedly agreed and began dropping hints to the ministers, who then spoke to the Empress Dowager.
units.literal: Zhang Qing greatly approved and began sounding out the ministers to speak to the empress dowager.

units.zh: 太后朝，因問大臣。
units.en: At the next court audience, the Empress Dowager raised the matter with the ministers.
units.literal: At court, the empress dowager questioned the ministers.

units.zh: 大臣請立呂產為呂王。
units.en: The ministers petitioned to establish Lü Chan as the King of Lü.
units.literal: The ministers requested establishing Lü Chan as King of Lü.

units.zh: 太后賜張卿千斤金，張卿以其半與田生。
units.en: The Empress Dowager rewarded Zhang Qing with a thousand jin of gold, and Zhang Qing gave half of it to Tian Sheng.
units.literal: The empress dowager granted Zhang Qing a thousand jin of gold, and Zhang Qing gave half of it to Tian Sheng.

units.zh: 田生弗受，因說之曰：「呂產王也，諸大臣未大服。
units.en: Tian Sheng declined the gift and counseled him: 'Although Lü Chan has been made king, the great ministers are not yet fully won over.
units.literal: Tian Sheng did not accept it, and instead advised him: 'Lü Chan is now king, but the various ministers are not yet greatly convinced.

units.zh: 今營陵侯澤，諸劉，為大將軍，獨此尚觖望。
units.en: At present, the Marquis of Yingling, Liu Ze of the Liu clan, serves as Grand General, and he alone still harbors resentment.
units.literal: Now Marquis Yingling Ze, of the Liu clan, serves as Grand General, and he alone still harbors resentment.

units.zh: 今卿言太后，列十餘縣王之，彼得王，喜去，諸呂王益固矣。」
units.en: If you now speak to the Empress Dowager and have her enfeoff him as king over ten or more counties, he will be delighted and depart the capital, making the Lü kingships all the more secure.'
units.literal: If you speak to the empress dowager now and have her enfeoff him as king of more than ten counties, he will obtain kingship, leave happily, and the various Lü kingships will be even more secure.'

units.zh: 張卿入言，太后然之。
units.en: Zhang Qing entered the palace and presented the proposal. The Empress Dowager approved.
units.literal: Zhang Qing went in and spoke, and the empress dowager agreed to it.

units.zh: 乃以營陵侯劉澤為瑯邪王。
units.en: Accordingly, Liu Ze, the Marquis of Yingling, was made the King of Langya.
units.literal: Thus, Marquis Yingling Liu Ze was made King of Langye.

units.zh: 瑯邪王乃與田生之國。
units.en: The King of Langya then set out for his kingdom, taking Tian Sheng with him.
units.literal: The King of Langye then went to his kingdom with Tian Sheng.

units.zh: 田生勸澤急行，毋留。
units.en: Tian Sheng urged Liu Ze to travel with all haste and make no stops along the way.
units.literal: Tian Sheng urged Ze to proceed quickly without delay.

units.zh: 出關，太后果使人追止之，已出，即還。
units.en: Once they had passed through the frontier passes, the Empress Dowager did indeed send men in pursuit to stop them, but they had already left, and the pursuers returned empty-handed.
units.literal: They passed through the passes, and the empress dowager indeed sent people to pursue and stop them, but they had already left, so they returned.

units.zh: 及太后崩，瑯邪王澤乃曰：「帝少，諸呂用事，劉氏孤弱。」
units.en: When the Empress Dowager died, the King of Langya, Liu Ze, declared: 'The emperor is young. The Lü clan holds power, and the house of Liu is isolated and vulnerable.'
units.literal: When the empress dowager passed away, King Langye Ze said: 'The emperor is young, the various Lü hold power, the Liu clan is isolated and weak.'

units.zh: 乃引兵與齊王合謀西，欲誅諸呂。
units.en: He raised his troops and conspired with the King of Qi to march west, intending to destroy the Lü clan.
units.literal: He then led troops west in conspiracy with the King of Qi, wishing to execute the various Lü.

units.zh: 至梁，聞漢遣灌將軍屯滎陽，澤還兵備西界，遂跳驅至長安。
units.en: When they reached Liang, word came that the Han court had dispatched General Guan Ying to garrison Xingyang. Liu Ze sent his troops back to guard the western frontier and rode hard for Chang'an.
units.literal: When they reached Liang, hearing that Han had sent General Guan to garrison Xingyang, Ze returned his troops to defend the western border, then galloped swiftly to Chang'an.

units.zh: 代王亦從代至。
units.en: The King of Dai had also arrived from his domain.
units.literal: The King of Dai also arrived from Dai.

units.zh: 諸將相與瑯邪王共立代王為天子。
units.en: The generals and ministers, together with the King of Langya, jointly enthroned the King of Dai as the new Son of Heaven.
units.literal: The generals, together with the King of Langye, jointly established the King of Dai as Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 天子乃徙澤為燕王，乃復以瑯邪予齊，復故地。
units.en: The new emperor then transferred Liu Ze to become the King of Yan and restored Langya to the kingdom of Qi, returning it to its former territory.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven then moved Ze to become King of Yan, and returned Langye to Qi, restoring the old territory.

units.zh: 澤王燕二年，薨，謚為敬王。
units.en: After ruling Yan for two years, Liu Ze passed away and was posthumously titled King Jing, the Reverent.
units.literal: Ze ruled Yan for two years, passed away, and was given the posthumous title Reverent King.

units.zh: 傳子嘉，為康王。
units.en: The throne passed to his son Jia, who became King Kang, the Tranquil.
units.literal: He passed the throne to his son Jia, who became King Kang.

units.zh: 至孫定國，與父康王姬姦，生子男一人。
units.en: By the time of his grandson Dingguo, the king committed adultery with his father King Kang's concubine and fathered one son.
units.literal: Down to his grandson Dingguo, who committed adultery with his father King Kang's concubine and fathered one son.

units.zh: 奪弟妻為姬。
units.en: He also seized his younger brother's wife and took her as a concubine.
units.literal: He seized his younger brother's wife as a concubine.

units.zh: 與子女三人姦。
units.en: He also committed incest with three of his own daughters.
units.literal: He committed adultery with three daughters.

units.zh: 定國有所欲誅殺臣肥如令郢人，郢人等告定國，定國使謁者以他法劾捕格殺郢人以滅口。
units.en: Dingguo wished to have an official killed—Yingren, the magistrate of Feiru. When Yingren and others reported Dingguo's crimes, Dingguo had the court usher bring trumped-up charges against them, arresting and killing Yingren to silence him.
units.literal: Dingguo wished to have a minister killed—the magistrate of Feiru, a man from Ying. When the man from Ying and others reported Dingguo, Dingguo had the usher indict and arrest them on other charges, killing the man from Ying to silence them.

units.zh: 至元朔元年，郢人昆弟復上書具言定國陰事，以此發覺。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanshuo era, the brothers of the man from Ying submitted another memorial laying out all of Dingguo's secret crimes, and the matter was at last brought to light.
units.literal: In Yuanshuo year 1, the man from Ying's brothers submitted another memorial fully detailing Dingguo's secret affairs, and thus it was discovered.

units.zh: 詔下公卿，皆議曰：「定國禽獸行，亂人倫，逆天，當誅。」
units.en: The case was referred to the high ministers, who all concluded: 'Dingguo's conduct is that of a beast. He has violated the bonds of human morality and defied the will of Heaven. He deserves execution.'
units.literal: The edict was issued to the ministers, and all discussed saying: 'Dingguo's conduct is that of beasts, disrupting human relationships, opposing heaven—he should be executed.'

units.zh: 上許之。
units.en: The emperor gave his assent.
units.literal: The emperor approved it.

units.zh: 定國自殺，國除為郡。
units.en: Dingguo took his own life, and the kingdom was abolished and converted into a commandery.
units.literal: Dingguo committed suicide, and the state was abolished to become a commandery.

units.zh: 太史公曰：荊王王也，由漢初定，天下未集，故劉賈雖屬疏，然以策為王，填江淮之閒。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: The King of Jing owed his throne to the early days of the Han dynasty, when the realm had not yet been consolidated. Although Liu Jia was only distantly related to the imperial line, he was nonetheless made king as a matter of strategy, to anchor the region between the Yangtze and the Huai.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: King Jing became king because in the early Han, when the realm was not yet settled, thus although Liu Jia was distantly related, he was nevertheless made king through strategy, filling the region between the Jiang and Huai.

units.zh: 劉澤之王，權激呂氏，然劉澤卒南面稱孤者三世。
units.en: Liu Ze's kingship arose from a stratagem that exploited the power of the Lü clan, yet his line ultimately sat upon the throne, facing south as sovereign, for three generations.
units.literal: Liu Ze's kingship arose from a stratagem that stirred the Lü clan, yet Liu Ze's line ultimately faced south and ruled as independent kings for three generations.

units.zh: 事發相重，豈不為偉乎！
units.en: That events unfolded in such momentous succession—is this not truly remarkable!
units.literal: Events unfolded one upon another in weight—how can this not be considered remarkable!

units.zh: 灌嬰追斬羽東 城。
units.en: Guan Ying pursued and beheaded Xiang Yu at Dongcheng.
units.literal: Guan Ying pursued and beheaded Xiang Yu at Dongcheng.

units.zh: 陳平、灌嬰將十萬守滎陽，樊噲、周勃將二十 萬定燕代，此聞帝崩，諸將皆誅，必連兵還鄉，以攻關中。
units.en: Chen Ping and Guan Ying are leading 100,000 men guarding Xingyang, and Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo are leading 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear that the emperor has died and that the generals are all being executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.
units.literal: Chen Ping and Guan Ying lead 100,000 guarding Xingyang, Fan Kuai and Zhou Bo lead 200,000 pacifying Yan and Dai. If they hear the emperor has died and the generals are all executed, they will surely join forces and return home to attack Guanzhong.

units.zh: 呂公女即呂后也，生孝惠帝、魯元公主。
units.en: This daughter of Lü Gong would become Empress Lü. She gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
units.literal: Lü Gong's daughter was namely Empress Lü, gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.

units.zh: 呂后與兩子居田中，有一老父過請飲，呂后因餔之。
units.en: Empress Lü lived in the countryside with their two children. An old man passed by and asked for a drink. Empress Lü fed him.
units.literal: Empress Lü and the two children resided in the fields, there was an old father who passed by requesting drink, Empress Lü because of this fed him.

units.zh: 老父相后曰：「夫人天下貴人也。」
units.en: The old man read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame, you are a noble person of the world."
units.literal: The old father read Empress Lü's face and said: "Madame is a noble person of the world."

units.zh: 老父已去，高祖適從旁舍來，呂后具言客有過，相我子母皆大貴。
units.en: The old man had already left. Emperor Gaozu had just returned from a neighboring house. Empress Lü told him everything: a guest had passed by and read the faces of her, the children, and her mother—they were all greatly noble.
units.literal: The old man had already left; Gaozu had just come from the neighboring house. Empress Lü told him in full that a guest had passed by and read the faces of her and her children—all were greatly noble.

units.zh: 高祖隱於芒、碭山澤間，呂后與人俱求，常得之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang. Empress Lü and others searched for him together and always found him.
units.literal: Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang, Empress Lu and others together sought him, constantly found him.

units.zh: 呂后曰：「季所居上常有雲氣，故從往常得季。」
units.en: Empress Lü said: "There are always clouds above where you stay. That's why we can always find you by following them."
units.literal: Empress Lu said: 'Where Ji resides above constantly has cloud aura, therefore following it constantly finds Ji.'

units.zh: 審食其從太公、呂后間行，反遇楚軍，羽常置軍中以為質。
units.en: Shen Yiji escorted the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü along hidden paths, but they encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu kept them with the army as hostages.
units.literal: Shen Yiji secretly escorted the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü, but encountered Chu troops. Xiang Yu constantly kept them in the army as hostages.

units.zh: 呂后兄周呂侯將兵居下邑，漢王往從之。
units.en: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.
units.literal: Empress Lü's elder brother Zhou Lühou led troops stationed at Xiayi. King Han went to join him.

units.zh: 九月，歸太公、呂后，軍皆稱萬歲。
units.en: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he returned the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü. The army all shouted ten thousand years.

units.zh: 卒與高祖。
units.en: In the end, she married Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: In the end he married with the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 九月，漢王遣將軍薛歐、王吸出武關，因王陵兵，從南陽迎太公、呂后於沛。
units.en: In the ninth month, the King of Han sent Generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out through Wuguan to join Wang Ling's troops and proceed from Nanyang to Pei to escort the Venerable Sire and Empress Lü.
units.literal: In the ninth month, King Han sent generals Xue Ou and Wang Xi out of Wuguan, relying on Wang Ling's troops, going from Nanyang to welcome the Duke of Tai and Empress Lü from Pei.

units.zh: 臣有息女，願為箕帚妾。」
units.en: I have a young daughter and wish to make her Ji's humble servant."
units.literal: I have a young daughter, wish to make her Ji's broom and dustpan servant."

units.zh: 酒罷，呂媼怒呂公曰：「公始常欲奇此女，與貴人。
units.en: After the wine ended, Lü Po angrily confronted Lü Gong: "You always said this daughter was exceptional and should marry someone noble.
units.literal: The wine ended, Lü Po became angry at Lü Gong and said: "You at first constantly wished to treat this daughter as exceptional, to match her with a noble person.

units.zh: 令相兩子，見孝惠帝，曰：「夫人所以貴者，乃此男也。」
units.en: He had him read the faces of the two children. When he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."
units.literal: She had him read the faces of the two children; when he saw Emperor Xiaohui, he said: "Madame's nobility comes from this male child."

units.zh: 老父曰：「鄉者夫人兒子皆以君，君相貴不可言。」
units.en: The old man said: "Just now, Madame and the children all take after you. Your appearance shows nobility beyond words."
units.literal: The old father said: 'Just now, madam and the children were all judged noble because of you; your features show nobility beyond words.'

units.zh: 九月，代相國陳豨反。
units.en: In the ninth month, Dai prime minister Chen Xi rebelled.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Dai prime minister Chen Xi rebelled.

units.zh: 上曰：「豨嘗為吾使，甚有信。
units.en: The emperor said: "Xi once served as my envoy and was very trustworthy.
units.literal: The emperor said: "Xi once served as my envoy and was very trustworthy.

units.zh: 周勃定代，斬陳豨於當城。
units.en: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.
units.literal: Zhou Bo pacified Dai and beheaded Chen Xi at Dangcheng.

units.zh: 代地吾所急，故封豨為列侯，以相國守代，今乃與 王黃等劫掠代地！
units.en: Dai territory is what concerns me urgently, so I enfeoffed Xi as a ranked marquis and had him guard Dai as Chancellor. Now he has joined Wang Huang and others in plundering Dai territory!
units.literal: Dai territory is what I consider urgent, so I enfeoffed Xi as a marquis to guard Dai as prime minister. Now he joins with Wang Huang and others to plunder Dai territory!

units.zh: 吏民非有罪也，能去豨、黃來歸者，皆赦之。」
units.en: Officials and people have no crime. Those who can leave Xi and Huang and return will all be pardoned."
units.literal: Officials and people have no crime. Those who can leave Xi and Huang and return will all be pardoned."

units.zh: 上喜曰：「豨不南據邯鄲而阻漳水，吾知其亡能為矣。」
units.en: The emperor was pleased and said: "Xi has not gone south to occupy Handan and block the Zhang River. I know he is incapable of doing anything."
units.literal: The emperor was pleased and said: "Xi does not occupy Handan to the south and block the Zhang River. I know he has no ability."

units.zh: 陳豨反，趙代地皆豨有。
units.en: Chen Xi has rebelled. Zhao and Dai territories are all Xi's.
units.literal: Chen Xi has rebelled. Zhao and Dai territories are all Xi's.

units.zh: 問豨將，皆 故賈人。
units.en: He questioned Xi's generals. They were all former merchants.
units.literal: He questioned Xi's generals. They were all former merchants.

units.zh: 乃多以金購豨將，豨將多降。
units.en: So he used much gold to buy Xi's generals. Xi's generals mostly surrendered.
units.literal: So he used much gold to buy Xi's generals. Xi's generals mostly surrendered.

units.zh: 豨將侯敞將萬餘人游行，王黃將騎千餘軍曲逆，張春將卒萬餘人度河攻聊城。
units.en: Xi's general Hou Chang led more than ten thousand men in roaming operations, Wang Huang led more than a thousand cavalry to camp at Quni, and Zhang Chun led more than ten thousand soldiers across the river to attack Liaocheng.
units.literal: Xi's general Hou Chang led over ten thousand men to roam, Wang Huang led over a thousand cavalry to camp at Qu Ni, Zhang Chun led over ten thousand troops to cross the river and attack Liaocheng.

units.zh: 豨將趙利守東垣，高祖攻之不下。
units.en: Xi's general Zhao Li defended Dongyuan. Gaozu attacked but could not take it.
units.literal: Xi's general Zhao Li defended Dongyuan. Gaozu attacked but could not take it.

units.zh: 陳豨降將言豨反時燕王盧綰使人之豨所陰謀。
units.en: Chen Xi's surrendering generals said that when Xi rebelled, King Yan Lu Wan sent people to Xi's place with secret plots.
units.literal: Chen Xi's surrendering generals said that when Xi rebelled, King Yan Lu Wan sent people to Xi's place with secret plots.

units.zh: 詔曰：「燕王綰與吾有故，愛之如子，聞與陳豨有謀，吾以為亡有，故使人迎綰。
units.en: The edict said: "King Lu Wan of Yan has old ties with me. I loved him like a son. When I heard that he had plotted with Chen Xi, I thought there was nothing to it, and so I sent people to welcome Lu Wan.
units.literal: The edict said: "King Yan Lu Wan has old relations with me. I love him like a son. Hearing he had plots with Chen Xi, I thought there was nothing to it, so I sent people to welcome Lu Wan.

units.zh: 文略嘗大遺魏收金，請為其父作佳傳，收論尒朱榮比韋、彭、伊、霍，蓋由是也。
units.en: Wenlüe once paid Wei Shou heavily to glorify his father in print—hence Shou’s likening of Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang.
units.literal: Wenlüe once gave Wei Shou a large gift of gold and asked him to write a fine biography of his father; that Wei Shou compared Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang was largely for this reason.

units.zh: 十一月，項羽殺宋義，并其兵渡河，自立為上將軍，諸將黥布等皆屬。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Xiang Yu killed Song Yi and took his troops, crossed the river, and established himself as supreme commander. Generals like Ying Bu and others all came under his command.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Xiang Yu killed Song Yi, merged his troops crossed the river, self-established as supreme general, various generals Ying Bu and others all belonged to him.

units.zh: 聞沛公已定關中，羽大怒，使黥布等攻破函谷關，遂至戲下。
units.en: When he heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong, Xiang Yu was furious and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then advanced to Xi.
units.literal: He heard that Pei Gong had already pacified Guanzhong. Xiang Yu was greatly angered and sent Ying Bu and others to break through Hangu Pass, then reached Xixia.

units.zh: 漢王西過梁地，至虞，謂謁者隨何曰：「公能說九江王布使舉兵畔楚，項王必留擊之。
units.en: The King of Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "Can you persuade Ying Bu, King of Jiujiang, to raise troops and rebel against Chu? Xiang Yu will certainly stay behind to attack him.
units.literal: King Han passed west through Liang territory and reached Yu. He said to the usher Sui He: "You can persuade King Jiujiang Ying Bu to raise troops and rebel against Chu. Xiang Yu will certainly stay to attack him.

units.zh: 隨何往說布，果使畔楚。
units.en: Sui He went to persuade Ying Bu, and indeed made him rebel against Chu.
units.literal: Sui He went to persuade Ying Bu, and indeed made him rebel against Chu.

units.zh: 隨何既說黥布，布起兵攻楚。
units.en: After Sui He persuaded Ying Bu, Bu raised troops to attack Chu.
units.literal: After Sui He persuaded Ying Bu, Bu raised troops to attack Chu.

units.zh: 楚使項聲、龍且攻布，布戰不勝。
units.en: Chu sent Xiang Sheng and Long Ju to attack Bu. Bu fought but was not victorious.
units.literal: Chu sent Xiang Sheng and Long Ju to attack Bu. Bu fought but was not victorious.

units.zh: 十二月，布與隨何間行歸漢。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Bu and Sui He secretly made their way back to Han.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Bu and Sui He secretly made their way back to Han.

units.zh: 漢王從其計，出軍宛葉間，與黥布行收兵。
units.en: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.
units.literal: King Han followed his plan, led troops out between Wan and Ye, and together with Ying Bu went to gather troops.

units.zh: 秋七月，立黥布為淮南王。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, he established Ying Bu as King of Huainan.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, he established Ying Bu as King of Huainan.

units.zh: 當陽君英布為九江王，都六。
units.en: Dangyang Lord Ying Bu as King of Jiujiang, capital at Liu.
units.literal: Dangyang Lord Ying Bu as King of Jiujiang, capital at Liu.

units.zh: 二年冬十月，項羽使九江王布殺義帝於郴。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter in the second year, Xiang Yu ordered King Jiujiang Ying Bu to kill Righteous Emperor Huai at Chen.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter in the second year, Xiang Yu ordered King Jiujiang Ying Bu to kill Righteous Emperor Huai at Chen.

units.zh: 漢王因使賈將九江兵，與太尉盧綰西南擊臨江王共尉，尉死，以臨江為南郡。
units.en: The King of Han then put Liu Jia in command of the Jiujiang forces. With Grand Commandant Lu Wan he struck southwest at Gong Wei, king of Linjiang. Gong Wei fell, and his domain was converted into Nan Commandery.
units.literal: The King of Han therefore ordered Liu Jia to lead the Jiujiang troops. Together with Grand Commandant Lu Wan he attacked King Gong Wei of Linjiang from the southwest. Gong Wei died, and Linjiang was reorganized as Nan Commandery.

units.zh: 又嘗令左右誦漢書，臥而聽之，至蒯通說韓信曰「相君之背，貴不可言」，寶應蹶然起曰「可謂智士」。
units.en: He once had his attendants read the Book of Han aloud while he listened from his couch. When they reached Kuai Tong's advice to Han Xin—"If you turn your back on Han, your rank will be beyond words"—Baoying sprang up and exclaimed, "A truly wise man!"
units.literal: He once had his attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. When they came to Kuai Tong telling Han Xin, "When I read your back, your nobility is beyond words," Baoying sprang up and said, "He can truly be called a wise man."

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 寄正色曰：「覆酈驕韓，未足稱智；
units.en: Ji answered sternly: "A man whose schemes destroyed Li Yiji and filled Han Xin with arrogance hardly deserves to be called wise.
units.literal: Ji said sternly: "Bringing ruin upon Li Yiji and making Han Xin arrogant is not enough to be called wisdom;

units.zh: 引兵與齊王合謀西，欲誅諸呂。
units.en: He led his troops to join the King of Qi in plotting a westward march to execute the Lü.
units.literal: He led his troops to join the King of Qi in plotting a westward march to execute the Lü.

units.zh: 漢亦遣人誘楚大司馬周殷。
units.en: Han also sent people to entice Chu grand marshal Zhou Yin.
units.literal: Han also sent people to entice Chu grand marshal Zhou Yin.

units.zh: 殷畔楚，以舒屠六，舉九江兵迎黥布，並行屠城父，隨劉賈皆會。
units.en: Zhou Yin rebelled against Chu, used troops from Shu to sack Liu, raised the forces of Jiujiang to welcome Qing Bu, and together they sacked Chengfu. They followed Liu Jia, and all the forces converged.
units.literal: Zhou Yin rebelled against Chu, used troops from Shu to sack Liu, raised the forces of Jiujiang to welcome Qing Bu, and together they sacked Chengfu. They followed Liu Jia, and all the forces converged.
